Organelle.subject: Important Days
Organelle.question: The _____ was Specialized subunit within a cell.
Organelle.fact: An organelle is a specialized subunit, within a biological cell, that has a specific function. The name organelle comes from the idea that these structures are parts of cells, as organs are to the body, hence organelle, the suffix -elle being a diminutive.

Organelle.subject: Important Days
Organelle.question: They include structures that make up the endomembrane system (such as the nuclear envelope, endoplasmic reticulum, and _____ apparatus), and other structures such as mitochondria and plastids
Organelle.fact: They include structures that make up the endomembrane system (such as the nuclear envelope, endoplasmic reticulum, and Golgi apparatus), and other structures such as mitochondria and plastids.

Organelle.subject: Important Days
Organelle.question: In the 1830s, Félix _____ refuted Ehrenberg's theory that microorganisms have the same organs as multicellular animals, only smaller
Organelle.fact: In the 1830s, Félix Dujardin refuted Ehrenberg's theory that microorganisms have the same organs as multicellular animals, only smaller.

Organelle.subject: Important Days
Organelle.question: Credited as the first to use a diminutive of organ (i.e., little organ) for cellular structures was German zoologist Karl August Möbius (_____), who used the term organula (plural of organulum, the di
Organelle.fact: Credited as the first to use a diminutive of organ (i.e., little organ) for cellular structures was German zoologist Karl August Möbius (1884), who used the term organula (plural of organulum, the diminutive of Latin organum).

Organelle.subject: Important Days
Organelle.question: Even more striking is the description of membrane-bound magnetosomes in magnetotactic bacteria, reported in _____
Organelle.fact: Even more striking is the description of membrane-bound magnetosomes in magnetotactic bacteria, reported in 2006.

Organelle.subject: Important Days
Organelle.question: The bacterial phylum _____ has revealed a number of compartmentalization features

Paper Mill Playhouse.question: In the late 1870s, _____ took over the property and used it for their paper making business until 1928

Paper Mill Playhouse.subject: Important Days
Paper Mill Playhouse.question: In 1971, the _____ staged its first production of The Nutcracker at Paper Mill with world-renowned dancer Edward Villella in the role of the Cavalier
Paper Mill Playhouse.fact: In 1971, the New Jersey Ballet staged its first production of The Nutcracker at Paper Mill with world-renowned dancer Edward Villella in the role of the Cavalier.

Paper Mill Playhouse.subject: Important Days
Paper Mill Playhouse.question: In 1998 Paper Mill staged a landmark production of _____'s Follies led by music director Tom Helm which Sondheim described as the first staging of the musical to utilize the complete score
Paper Mill Playhouse.fact: In 1998 Paper Mill staged a landmark production of Stephen Sondheim's Follies led by music director Tom Helm which Sondheim described as the first staging of the musical to utilize the complete score.
